description: Save a private file for this account. Pass name and content_text or content_base64. Returns the file id and metadata. Does not share the file. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

content_base64.description: Standard or url-safe base64. A data:*;base64, prefix is stripped. Example: aGk=

content_text.description: UTF-8 text. Pass exactly one of content_text or content_base64.

mime.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file name when omitted.

name.description: File name with an extension. No slashes or control characters.

name: save_file
title: Save a file
